mapper.insert: INSERT INTO async_job( plan_instance_id, node_id, session_id, turn_id, tool_call_id, external_job_id, status, callback_topic, callback_url, payload_json ) VALUES( #{planInstanceId}, #{nodeId}, #{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{toolCallId}, #{externalJobId}, #{status}, #{callbackTopic}, #{callbackUrl}, #{payloadJson} )
mapper.update: UPDATE async_job SET status = #{status}, payload_json = #{payloadJson}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE external_job_id = #{externalJobId}
